events.title: Translations, Map Marker, Slight Changes
events.summary: Added mostly complete translations!I've also added a new objective marker for new players who got lost while playing.As well as more objects within the demo maps.Thank you for playing my Demo and the feedback I have received, it has resulted in my figuring out new strategies on how to make it more bearable for newer players who aren't used to this type of game!I strive to give an overall great experience for players familiar with the genre of game I am making as well as anyone who is just curiou

events.title: Demo Update: Localization & UI Bug Fix
events.summary: Okay! Now that I am off of work for a bit I quickly found a 'good' solution to localization and pushed out the update a day before this post.Changes:Added first five languages for localizationOnly affects NPC dialog & mission descriptions - for now.Please let me know if any dialog in any of the languages does not match or is off! It's not fully implemented but I did want to show that I am working on it and that I am serious about localizing it.Tons more to do,Natrapseht

events.title: Demo Update: Linux Build & NPC Accessory Fix
events.summary: Hey everyone!Thank you so much for checking the game out in any way!Just wanted to push a small hotfix & news blurb announcing the following:Fixed Security NPCs not having their weapon visibleNative Linux BuildLet me know if there are any issues as I only use Windows to work on the game so there could be some Linux specific issues!Got a long road ahead but I am more than eager to see this to the end; and more maybe?Thank you all so very much again,Natrapseht

events.title: Demo Update: NPC Fixes, Saved Variables, Achievement & More
events.summary: Very small update from things I have noticed while combing through the demo.Changes:Added a new disclaimer on the main menu screen - 'It indicates that this is the demo and everything is subject to change'Fixed NPC bugs:One where they would stop roaming after getting damaged or interacted with.Animations not playing when they needed to.More save variables:The game now saves:Controller sensitivityVibration stateMuted musicSilence - for the whole gameDisabling fog - for performanceV-sync - should'

events.title: Initial Run Released!
events.summary: Thank you ALL; for viewing the game's store page and those who downloaded and tried the demo out!Future actions are that I plan to solely focus on developing the rest of Project Quickgunner without further changes to the demo - however if there were / are any game-breaking bugs that need to be addressed, do not hesitate to let me know so I can try my fastest to get rid of them!Mindset towards full-release onward: Version 1.0 will be the game's release version; there will be no early access.Ideal
